mechanism.claim: A prior-range breakout can persist when delayed inventory adjustment, stop/hedge flow and heterogeneous trend participation create directional continuation; the same architecture is vulnerable to whipsaw in range regimes and to fee drag when move scale is too small.
mechanism.payer_constraint: Hedgers, late inventory adjusters, stop flow and slower participants may pay trend followers during persistent moves; repeated false breakouts and transaction costs are the principal countervailing forces.
mechanism.source_method_fidelity: ZEL v2 uses a closed-bar prior-range Donchian event, a separate directional-structure proxy, volatility-normalized risk geometry, channel/ATR invalidation and bounded profitable-only pyramiding eligibility. It does not claim to reproduce any paper portfolio, universe, rebalance cadence or optimized parameter set.
mechanism.architecture_kill_condition: Kill this specification if frozen prospective controls do not distinguish the breakout/regime mechanism from direction-flip/time-placebo/regime-permutation controls, or if realistic net expectancy remains non-positive under the SSOT sample/retention gate.

practitioner_patterns.entry_confirmation: Break prior closed-bar range; do not use the signal bar inside its own channel. Directional structure is a separate regime proxy, not an extra alpha claim.
regime_no_trade: prospective move-budget below verified cost budget
practitioner_patterns.long_short: symmetric structural rules; side-specific economics must be reported separately prospectively
practitioner_patterns.stop: initial volatility-distance stop plus opposite shorter-channel structural invalidation
practitioner_patterns.target_runner: no fixed profit target required; channel exit is the structural exit and runner ownership is explicit
practitioner_patterns.pyramiding: eligible only after favorable movement, bounded units, never adverse dip-add/martingale
practitioner_patterns.sizing: fixed equity-risk fraction divided by stop distance with hard notional exposure cap
practitioner_patterns.cooldown_turnover: one transition signal per breakout; duplicate entries on bars already outside the channel are forbidden
practitioner_patterns.execution: policy consumes a verified round-trip cost budget; fill/fee/spread/slippage/funding/latency remain execution-adapter ownership

failure_modes: range-bound whipsaw and repeated false breakouts
volatility expansion that widens stop distance and reduces feasible size
short-horizon fee/spread/slippage drag overwhelming gross move
stale or incomplete OHLCV causing false channel boundaries
duplicate signals while price remains beyond a prior breakout
unbounded pyramiding or adverse averaging converting trend following into martingale risk
funding exposure on long holds if settlement cost is omitted

cost_architecture.official_bingx_reference: VIP0 perpetual taker 5 bps/side, maker 2 bps/side; maker is reference-only without verified fill probability/adverse-selection model
cost_architecture.policy_rule: verified_round_trip_cost_bps is injected from frozen cost authority; policy may reject structurally uneconomic entries but may not lower the cost assumption

sources.author: Tobias J. Moskowitz; Yao Hua Ooi; Lasse Heje Pedersen
sources.mechanism_claim: Return persistence is documented across liquid futures over intermediate horizons, with evidence consistent with delayed reaction and with speculators earning against hedger flow.
sources.implementation_lesson: Treat persistence as the mechanism; a breakout/channel is only an observable proxy and must be tested prospectively rather than inheriting the paper's portfolio result.
sources.limitations: Traditional futures, monthly-scale study; not a direct BTC perpetual or 1h Donchian validation.

sources.author: Nitish Poluri
sources.mechanism_claim: BTC Donchian breakout performance is sensitive to volatility regimes, parameters, transaction costs and market conditions.
sources.implementation_lesson: Separate the breakout event from ATR risk/regime treatment and make transaction-cost sensitivity an explicit falsification axis.
sources.limitations: Narrow independent study; backtest evidence is not promotion evidence for ZEL.

sources.author: Carlo Zarattini; Alberto Pagani; Andrea Barbon
sources.mechanism_claim: Donchian-based trend models with volatility-based sizing can be studied net of fees across a survivorship-bias-free crypto universe.
sources.implementation_lesson: Keep signal and volatility sizing separate, report costs explicitly, and do not assume one lookback or one asset generalizes.
sources.limitations: Portfolio methodology and universe differ from ZEL single-strategy BTC/ETH perpetual deployment.

sources.author: Charles Chevalier; Serge Darolles
sources.mechanism_claim: Observed trend-following costs depend on liquidity/execution quality and market volatility, so gross trend evidence cannot be separated from implementation costs.
sources.implementation_lesson: Freeze realistic execution costs and turnover before economics; no fee rescue after outcomes.
sources.limitations: Institutional traditional-futures dataset, not BingX crypto perps.

sources.author: BingX
sources.mechanism_claim: Perpetual futures VIP0 reference fees are taker 0.05% and maker 0.02%; funding transfers between longs and shorts.
sources.implementation_lesson: Use 5 bps/side taker as conservative fee authority unless independently verified account-tier evidence says otherwise; maker fee alone is not a fill model.
sources.limitations: Fee schedule does not provide strategy-specific spread/slippage/fill probability.

sources.author: gabekutner
sources.mechanism_claim: Open-source practitioner implementation separates N/ATR sizing, channel entry, favorable-move unit adds, stops and exits.
sources.implementation_lesson: Preserve separate ownership for entry, sizing, favorable-only pyramiding, stops and exits; use as implementation-pattern evidence only.
sources.limitations: Small community project; not profitability evidence and not a BingX implementation.

sources.author: Snorkle1990
sources.mechanism_claim: A public practitioner variant uses breakout entries, ATR stop geometry, favorable pyramiding and channel exits.
sources.implementation_lesson: Treat MA confirmation and parameter values as hypotheses; preserve profitable-only add semantics and explicit exit ownership.
sources.limitations: Community implementation, low popularity and no authority over parameters or alpha.
